name: Words Demo
summary:
Chain letters through a 3D grid and hunt down hidden words before time runs out. You’re drawing a path from neighbor to neighbor, trying to spot what’s tucked into the layout while the clock keeps pushing you forward. 

Rack up a higher score with longer finds, watch your progress climb, and tap a hint when your brain goes blank. You can also move and turn the board so the puzzle sits just right, great for a quick word game break or a longer “one more round” session.
